mapper.select: WITH action_period AS ( SELECT strategy_option_id, MAX(end_date) AS execution_end_date FROM strategy_action WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY strategy_option_id ) SELECT selection.final_selection_id, strategy_case.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, action_period.execution_end_date, result.achievement_rate, result.start_risk_stock_qty, result.end_risk_stock_qty, result.start_expected_disposal_qty, result.end_expected_disposal_qty, result.estimated_loss_savings_amount FROM strategy_execution_result result JOIN final_strategy_selection selection ON selection.final_selection_id = result.final_selection_id AND selection.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 AND strategy_case.case_status = 'EXECUTION_COMPLETED' JOIN action_period ON action_period.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id WHERE result.is_deleted = 0 AND action_period.execution_end_date BETWEEN #{fromDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{toDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY action_period.execution_end_date, selection.final_selection_id
